statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below the blocking threshold while geopolitical Stress is extreme.
recommendation: Current Tail evidence remains low; the principal conditional risk window is the U.S. data and cash-open cluster from 12:25 to 14:30 UTC.
headline: Orderly overnight Nasdaq futures despite extreme geopolitical headline stress
body: Nasdaq futures were about 0.2% higher in early Asian trading while two- and ten-year Treasury yields eased and Brent held near $88.50. Strait of Hormuz shipping was near a standstill after tanker attacks and U.S.-Iran talks remained stalled. Fresh bar-level evidence of repeated extension or failed retracements was unavailable, so Tail remains low while Stress stays extreme.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 clock-hours, Tail stayed in the 17-19 low band. Stress remained extreme at 84-90 as geopolitical risk built; the Sunday futures reopening briefly shifted the mode to event/whipsaw before later assessments returned to mixed.

forecast.analysis: Observed cross-asset conditions are modestly constructive rather than strongly aligned: Nasdaq futures were about 0.2% higher, Treasury yields eased, and oil was steady. No fresh bar-level evidence confirms failed pullbacks or one-way extension.
